headline: Pakistan Central Bank Foreign Exchange Reserves Edge Up to $21.49 Billion
summary: The State Bank of Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves rose by $19 million in the week ended October 16 to reach $21.488 billion.
why: Pakistan's central bank reserve position is vital for debt servicing, currency stability, and ongoing external financing arrangements.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Incremental additions to official reserves help stabilize import cover and foreign debt obligations.
